description:
The image depicts a pizza with two slices removed, showcasing its toppings and crust. The pizza is constructed on a circular crust with a golden-brown crust, topped with a layer of cheese, tomato sauce, and various toppings.

The toppings appear to be a mixture of vegetables and meat, including what is likely sausage or meatballs, nestled amongst chunks of red and orange bell peppers. The pizza is positioned on a wooden surface, which serves as the background of the image.
